name: srvname-service-only-permit-valid
description: RFC 4985 §4: a service-only SRVName constraint (_mail, no DNS part) is satisfied by ANY SRVName SAN that includes the same service name. A SAN of _mail.example.com is therefore in the permitted subtree _mail.
notes: RFC 4985 §4 example: constraint _mail matches both _mail.example.com and _mail.1example.com.
